brief.plain_summary: Evaluate any frame of a pinned scene recipe directly by its number in one aspect, draw chosen frames as standalone SVGs, and confirm that forward, backward and shuffled evaluation give identical frame hashes.

required: Verify every pin, then use an installation of this pack's code whose files match the tool card's code digest.
Read the recipe file the recipe noun pins and verify its SHA-256 before evaluating anything.
Evaluate every frame with evaluate_frame forward, backward and in a shuffled order, and compare the three lists of frame hashes.
Stop with unknown if any frame hash differs between orders; report the first frame that differs.
Draw each requested frame with render_svg_frame and record its frame hash and the SVG's SHA-256.
Return follow-up work the results justify as proposed_verbs and nouns worth creating later as proposed_nouns. Never enqueue them yourself; an authorized requester decides which to run.

brief.title: Check a rendered video
brief.plain_summary: Run the eight post-encode checks on each rendered MP4 against its sequence plan: streams, exact frames and duration, frame spot checks with SSIM, black and frozen frames, integrated loudness, caption timing and the disclosure.
brief.outcome: One video QA report per aspect with every check's result and a receipt digest.

sequence.description: Pin of the sequence noun that was rendered.

render_manifests.description: Pins of the render manifests to check.

videos.description: Pins of the rendered MP4 media nouns.

output_store.description: Store for the produced nouns. The default is a placeholder; use the store your owner assigned.

output_contract.delivery: Write produced nouns surface_only under your own authenticated surface, which is the requester's assigned surface, so the requester and that surface's reviewers can read them. Never use public_commons or allowlist other surfaces. Return every produced noun's pin in output.artifacts; add its value when the requester asks for inline delivery.

outcome_meanings.checked: The declared nouns were produced and every deterministic acceptance check passed.
outcome_meanings.no_change: The evidence does not justify producing or changing anything. Say why.
outcome_meanings.unknown: The question could not be answered with the permitted inputs. List what is missing and what would resolve it.
outcome_meanings.blocked: A required input, permission or capability is missing. Ask one precise question.

acceptance_checks.check: Every produced noun validates against template.video-qa-report's schema.
The code that ran matches the tool card's code digest.
All eight video checks appear once in every report.
passed is true exactly when every check passed.
Each report's mp4_sha256 and render_manifest_sha256 match the pinned nouns.

creates.nouns: The worker writes the nouns listed in output_contract.produces and returns their pins.
creates.verbs: The worker proposes follow-up verbs in output.proposed_verbs, such as a breakdown into smaller verbs or a research follow-up, with the pins they need. Proposals are never enqueued by the worker; an authorized requester enqueues the ones worth doing.

required: Verify every pin, then use an installation of this pack's code whose files match the tool card's code digest.
Inspect the render's outcome and verify the MP4 and manifest digests before measuring; a finished render is not proof that it succeeded.
Run video-motion video check with the sequence and the render directory. It confines every path and verifies every recorded digest before FFmpeg runs, and never executes the manifest's commands.
A failed check is a result to report, not an error to retry away; keep every report.
Return follow-up work the results justify as proposed_verbs and nouns worth creating later as proposed_nouns. Never enqueue them yourself; an authorized requester decides which to run.
preferred: Run on a different worker than the one that rendered the video.

required_capabilities: read permitted noun versions
an installation of this pack's code that matches its digest
write candidate nouns in the requester's scope

execution.inference_allowance: Existing authorized worker allowance only. This template grants no provider credit, spending authority or server inference.

network.detail: Only to fetch the pack library at the pinned commit and the code's Python packages from PyPI when no qualified installation exists; no other host.

instantiation.rule: Replace each slot with exact NounRef pins, set the params, then recompute the idempotency key with scripts/build_packs.py --instantiate. Enqueue only with your own grants in a queue your owner assigned.

execution_report.purpose: Lets later runs of this template be fingerprinted and compared. It is worker reported, not proof.
